bot_squeeze_bull_v1.method: Live config read: capital 10,000 (bots/squeeze_bull/config.py:13); fixed-R 1% over the 2% stop, 3x cap (config.py:35-36; botlib.size_intent_fixed_r botlib.py:555-577) = 0.5x notional = $5,000 on every fire (asserted notional_x==0.5 for all rows); stop -2%, target +3%, TIF 48h from entry (strategy/config.py:32-34; signal.py:252-254); stop checked before target (signal.py:147-159); single-open guard (signal.py:235-236); cooldown is over flush EVENTS and is already in the research event list, so it needs no re-application; booked cost 7 bp RT + 0 slippage on notional (strategy/config.py:50-51, signal.py:102-107 -> trades.compute_perp_close trades.py:342), funding booked (apply_funding=True, signal.py:107; trades.py:354-356). Per trade: value = [0.5*10000*pnl_frac - 0.5*10000*7/1e4 + 0.5*10000*F/100] / 10000 * 100, where pnl_frac is the S1 P0_shipped walk outcome in venue (perp) terms and F = funding.accrued_pct('BTC', entry, exit, LONG) reproduced exactly (-100 * sum fr_close over settlements with timestamp % 28800 == 0 in (entry, exit], funding.py:112-118,138); entry = signal_ts (trigger bar close), exit = entry+48h for time stops (asserted equal to the walk's last bar close) else close of the exit 1 m bar. Single-open: chronological by entry, a fire is dropped if its entry < exit of the last kept trade (live sweeps before evaluating, so entry == prior exit is kept). Mean decomposition (% capital/trade): price +0.3306, cost -0.0350, funding -0.0116. Exit kinds kept: 47 target, 41 stop, 29 time. Since 1% risk = 1 R, % of capital = net R here. For the dashboard's reference: iid resampled 10th percentile of the mean (20k draws, seed 42) at n=5/10/20/30: -0.359 / -0.160 / -0.036 / +0.024.
bot_squeeze_bull_v1.caveats: (1) Exit model is the RESEARCH walk: 1 m spot high/low touch, filled at the level, levels in perp terms tested against the spot path (exec_lib.context exec_lib.py:475-492). Live instead polls the last CLOSED 1 m spot close every 60 s and fills AT that close (price_feed.py:79-88, signal.py:142-159), and books perp entry vs spot exit (mixed venue). Sensitivity with that poll model on the same fires (its own single-open): n 115, mean +0.310 vs +0.284 here, i.e. research convention is ~0.03 pp/trade lower, so the AMBER threshold is marginally less sensitive, not more. (2) One entry-basis outlier: 2023-03-24 11:00 trigger bar, perp close 186 bp below spot; kept exactly as the study walked it (stop). Median entry basis -2.4 bp. (3) Funding before 2026-04-25 comes from hourly predicted-rate rows taken at 8h boundaries - what the live function books on that table, not verified against actual settlements; every trade had the expected settlement count (no gaps). (4) S1 cost 6.7 bp replaced by the booked 7 bp; research was run with no funding - both corrected here. (5) Not modelled: 60 s tick timing, stale-feed entry refusals, the scheduled-exit backstop (fallback only). (6) Live trades closed before 2026-09-12 booked 15 bp, and SJ-4250 held 47 h under the pre-2026-09-13 schedule (docs/calibration/squeeze_bull.md:118-119,176); exclude or flag them when comparing. (7) Statistical base is thin (DSR 0.72-0.73, OOS margins one fire wide per the calibration log).
bot_squeeze_bull_v1.notes:
What these numbers are. Each value is one research trade under the live bot's current sizing and booked costs: net pnl_usdt / 10,000 * 100. That is the same unit as the dashboard's live metric. Costs are the booked 7 bp (squeeze_bull) and 10 bp (short_squeeze) on notional, charged once (trades.py:342). Funding is added using the live function's own query (funding.py:112-118,138). Trades are filtered to what one position per variant allows, and each list is in exit order (one open position means entry order equals exit order). Nothing was tuned. No repo file, prod.db or process was touched: prod.db was opened mode=ro only, and all output is in the scratchpad.

Per-trade outcomes. squeeze_bull uses the saved S1 walks in studies/notebooks/sizing_style_2026_09/results/s1_trades.csv (P0_shipped and P1b_target_only). short_squeeze needed a recompute for one reason: the live cooldown counts from the last TAKEN trade (bots/short_squeeze/strategy/signal.py:376-380 and 541), while the research cooldown counts from every trigger (exec_lib.py:359). I rebuilt the raw trigger mask with a verbatim copy of exec_lib.short_squeeze_frame and walked it with sizing_lib.run_policy. The research cooldown on that mask reproduces the S1 71 exactly, and every re-walked trade matches the saved pnl_frac to 1e-12.

Summary (mean % of capital per trade / win rate / n):
- bot_squeeze_bull_v1: +0.284 / 58% / 117
- bot_squeeze_bull_nostop_v1: +0.426 / 67% / 103
- bot_short_squeeze_v1: +0.068 / 44% / 71
- bot_short_squeeze_nostop_v1: +0.027 / 63% / 62
Each variant's caveats list the iid 10th percentile of resampled means at n = 5/10/20/30. At n = 10 they are -0.160 / -0.057 / -0.516 / -0.628, so an AMBER rule needs a minimum n or it will almost never fire.

Biggest approximation, same for all four. The values use the research exit model: 1 m spot high/low touches, filled at the level, in perp terms. Live polls the last closed 1 m spot close every 60 s, fills at that close, and books a perp entry against a spot exit. I re-ran a sensitivity with that live polling model. Live-style means come out higher on every variant: +0.310 / +0.454 / +0.104 / +0.075. The two short_squeeze gaps are mainly perp entries averaging -5.1 bp vs spot. So the reference is conservative in the sense that it will not cause false AMBERs, but it slightly weakens the warning. The poll model is my own re-derivation, not study code, so it is only a sensitivity.

Findings worth your attention (observations, nothing changed):
(a) bot_short_squeeze_nostop_v1 is close to break-even in dollars at 1x notional even though its R mean is +0.80. Its edge sits in the tight-stop triggers that fixed-R sizing levered up. The '~1/2.5 of the stop variant's dollars' comment (bots/short_squeeze/config.py:41) does not hold: this variant earns less per trade than the stop variant.
(b) Live paper P&L mixes venues: entry at the perp close (squeeze_bull signal.py:242; short_squeeze signal.py:475) and exit at the btc_1m spot close (price_feed.py:14-16, 79-88). The recut_lib divergence check (D4) splits out funding and backstop cost but not this basis, which is about 5 bp of notional on short_squeeze.
(c) One squeeze_bull fire (trigger bar 2023-03-24 11:00) has perp 186 bp below spot. It is kept as the study walked it.
(d) docs/calibration/squeeze_bull.md:125 dates the S1 pool '2022-01 → 2026-06'; the fires actually run 2022-03-25 → 2026-09-04.

Comparing against live. Exclude, or flag, live trades booked before 2026-09-12 (15 bp squeeze_bull, 25 bp short_squeeze). Also flag SJ-4250 (47 h hold under the old time-stop schedule).

Working tree. While I worked, another session had uncommitted edits in botlib.py, both runners and strategies/trades.py. They route the scheduled-exit backstop through each sleeve's own close function and add a guard for close races. They do not change sizing, costs or funding for normal sweep closes, so the baseline is unaffected. The running processes still use whatever code they loaded at start. No mutation-drill entries are proposed; this task changes no code.

bot_squeeze_bull_nostop_v1.method: Live config: use_stop False (bots/squeeze_bull/config.py:25); fixed notional NOSTOP_NOTIONAL_X = 1%/2% = 0.5x capital = $5,000 (config.py:42; runner.py:76-93); +3% target and 48h-from-entry time stop only (signal.py:252-269, _stop_price None); single-open (signal.py:235-236); 7 bp RT booked on notional + funding (strategy/config.py:50-51; signal.py:102-107). Per trade: value = [5000*pnl_frac - 5000*7/1e4 + 5000*F/100] / 10000 * 100, F = accrued LONG funding over (entry, exit] with funding.accrued_pct semantics (funding.py:112-118,138); exit = entry+48h for time exits, else close of the 1 m bar that touched the target. Single-open applied chronologically (entry >= last kept exit). Mean decomposition (% capital/trade): price +0.4788, cost -0.0350, funding -0.0174. Exit kinds kept: 58 time, 45 target. R vs the 2% reference distance = % of capital. Resampled 10th percentile of the mean (iid, 20k, seed 42) at n=5/10/20/30: -0.250 / -0.057 / +0.091 / +0.153.
bot_squeeze_bull_nostop_v1.caveats: (1) Research touch-and-level exit model vs live 60 s close polling with perp entry / spot exit (see stop variant); poll-model sensitivity: n 102, mean +0.454 vs +0.426 here. (2) Worst trade -4.24% of capital (the replay's -4.17 R plus cost/funding); the distribution is left-skewed, so iid mean resampling at small n is wide. (3) Funding pre-2026-04-25 from hourly predicted-rate rows at 8h boundaries (live function's semantics; not checked against settlements). Longer holds make funding ~1.5x the stop variant's. (4) Research cost 6.7 bp -> booked 7 bp; research had no funding - both corrected. (5) The single-open drop set (19 fires) is determined by research exit times; live close polling could shift a few boundaries. (6) The variant has been live only since 2026-09-12 (registered event); do not compare trades booked before then. (7) 2023-03-24 entry-basis outlier kept as walked (time exit -0.42%).
